title: How to Monetize TikTok: Requirements, Payouts and Every Income Path Compared
summary: Learn how to monetize TikTok with the current Creator Rewards requirements, view thresholds, country eligibility and a side-by-side comparison of payouts per path.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### How many TikTok followers do I need to make $2,000 a month?


TikTok does not publish a follower count that guarantees $2,000 a month, and earnings depend on qualified views and revenue path rather than followers alone. Many creators reach that income level faster through brand deals and TikTok Shop affiliate commissions.


### Which countries are allowed to monetize TikTok?


TikTok monetization availability varies by program and changes over time. Markets with confirmed availability include the United States, United Kingdom, Brazil, and Mexico, though not every monetization path is offered in every market. Verify the specific feature you want in TikTok's in-app monetization area and official Creator Academy pages for your region.


### How do you withdraw money from TikTok to PayPal?


TikTok withdrawal options depend on your region and the program that generated the earnings, so check the balance and payout settings inside the app for the exact methods available to you. Confirm your account details before requesting a withdrawal, and review TikTok's official help pages for current regional payment terms.


### How do you set up a TikTok Shop?


TikTok Shop setup starts in the TikTok Shop Seller Center, where you register as a seller, submit business or individual verification documents, and connect a bank account for payouts. Once approved, you list products and can activate affiliate programs so creators sell for you on commission.


### Why was my Creator Rewards application declined if I met the follower and view thresholds?


Read the stated reason in your decision notice, address that specific issue, and follow TikTok's instructions before applying again.


### What counts as a qualified view on TikTok Creator Rewards?


A qualified view is a view that meets TikTok Creator Rewards qualification rules, and it is not the same as the total view count shown in your analytics. Only eligible videos longer than one minute can earn, and payment is calculated on qualified views rather than every play. Check TikTok's Creator Academy for the current qualification criteria.


### Which TikTok monetization path should I choose for my content?


Choose your monetization path based on fit with your content routine, not an assumed payout. Creator Rewards suits creators publishing videos longer than one minute, LIVE Gifts and subscriptions reward ongoing audience participation, brand deals depend on negotiation, and Shop affiliate earnings follow product sales and seller commission terms.
